theme: A day at sea, a short list waiting ashore.
greeting: You're mid-charter on the Dalmatian coast, Dan, and the day is genuinely open, with just a 15-minute check-in with Mike on the calendar. The only real weight is a handful of travel bookings that want dry land and a signal.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: On the Mike + Dan board, the Portland full-size SUV for Christmas week is flagged book-this-week and comes due tomorrow. Holiday PWM inventory is thin and sells out, so a refundable hold now costs nothing and closes the risk.

needsAttention.title: Car and St Pete gap still open
needsAttention.detail: You land TPA Sunday the 20th, but the Sept 20 to Oct 5 full-size SUV and the two-night St Pete stay before the Orlando villa are both still unbooked, both marked p1 on the board.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Sept 19-20 disembark
needsAttention.detail: The charter ends Saturday noon at Komolac. The Cavtat transfer, a bag hold before the 3 PM check-in, express checkout for the 5:15 AM Sunday flight, and the airport taxi all still need arranging while you have signal ashore.

flagged.title: Two governance roles in your alerts
flagged.detail: LinkedIn surfaced an EU AI Act SVP, Strategy role and a NYT VP, Government Affairs, both squarely in your lane, waiting for whenever you are back online.

flagged.title: Fidium payment confirmed
flagged.detail: Your Fidium bill went through, confirmation only, nothing owed.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters, NYT Cooking, WSJ, market and language digests, plus a Care.com applicant and an Airbnb review.
inbox.clear: Nothing in the inbox is waiting on your reply.

recipe.title: Chicken and Chickpea Tagine
recipe.why: An autumn braise that leans on what the cooler months bring — warming spices, chickpeas, and long, gentle heat.

acts.line: A 15-minute check-in with Mike at nine, then the water is yours.
Nothing scheduled, so the charter has the afternoon end to end.
An open evening aboard, with nothing on the calendar pulling at you.
